title: Origins: Atrocious Fish [Magikarp and Gyrados]
description: Start the game as a little Magikarp and fight your way to evolving into the rage-filled Gyrados
body:
**REQUIRES THE [ORIGINS MOD](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) BY APACE** # Begin your journey as: ## ![A mildly derpy pixel art rendition of Magikarp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d23a0296019f733b294a5684583344831ab5acf9.png) Magikarp **Magikarp, the fish Pokemon. In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.**

Splash: Splash around aimlessly. - Splash with [Primary] Fish: You have gills, allowing you to breathe underwater but not on land. You can swim, see, and mine much better than average underwater as well. - Toggle water vision with [Secondary] Pathetic: A Pokemon so pathetic it astounds researchers, you are very small and kind of weak. Swift Swim: You move much faster in the rain. # _Defeat 3 Elder Guardians to evolve into:_ ## ![A basic pixel art rednition of Gyrados](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebcfb2ac31597e2ba9b8e9984316a67e65b80a9c.png) Gyrados **Gyrados, the atrocious Pokemon. Once Gyarados goes on a rampage, its ferociously violent blood doesn't calm until it has burned everything down. There are records of this Pokemon's rampages lasting a whole month.**

Rampage: Whilst in battle, you go into a state of blinded rage. During this, you cannot naturally regenerate but every hit you land has a chance to heal you. Big Splash: Now a flying type, you can leap high into the air. - Leap with [Primary] but note you still take fall damage Hyper Beam: Focus and charge up a powerful beam of destruction to fire at foes. Though it is powerful, it requires massive amounts of energy, and you will need to slow down afterward. - Charge with [Secondary], but be careful, as being hit will cause the beam to lose charge Intimidate: No longer weak, your intimidating presence weakens those around you at the beginning of battle. Bigger Fish: You still have gills and the various survival tools needed underwater, however you can now last twice as long on land and are 3 times your original size. - Toggle water vision with [Save Toolbar], it and your water speed have both improved Double Weakness: You are extremely vulnerable to electric damage.
